sentences.japanese: 君は危険な領域に踏み込んでいるよ。
君に会い損ねて地団駄を踏んだよ。
sentences.english: I was chagrined at missing you.

sentences.japanese: 極小の虫でも踏まれれば、そりくり返る。
sentences.english: Even the smallest worm will turn if trodden on.

sentences.japanese: 割れたガラスを踏むな。
sentences.english: Don't step on the broken glass.

sentences.japanese: 階段を踏みはずして足首を捻挫したようです。
sentences.english: I missed a step on the stairs and I'm afraid I sprained my ankle.
